NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author updated the before/after screenshots and the self-review checklist, then pushed one small update (+8 lines, same commit). The design thread now has approval from Daniel K, and the author's comment links to it.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Design direction approved in #design: Daniel K said "these look good", including the title-only and narrow-window cases he asked for, and chose the text-only card over a placeholder image. |
| ✅  | Before/after screenshots are in the description for the three cases: text-only, with image, and no metadata. |
| ✅  | The checklist now matches the PR template. |
| ℹ️  | CI status isn't visible here (the author says checks pass), so check it before merge. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — gave the earlier feedback and knows what was asked for.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready" and "design review", add "maintainer review", and assign @laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the screenshots and getting the design sign-off. @laurynmm, could you review this?
```
